snippet.title: Shroomveil Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Join the Playtest and Whishlist Shroomveil on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3997510/Shroomveil/?utm_source=youtube_trailer

Shroomveil is a real-time combat, Action RPG, with character progression, skills, and gear upgrades. Set in a magical, mushroom-filled world full of danger and discovery, you'll explore a beautiful fantasy land, find and defend villages, equip warriors, clear dungeons, defeat bosses, and bring peace.
